title: sclerochloa arenaria
intro: Sclerochloa arenaria, commonly known as sand bent or sand sedge, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory health. The health benefits of Sclerochloa arenaria include its ability to act as an expectorant, relieving coughs and congestion, and its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Sclerochloa arenaria include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
